zh-CN.title: 多人投稿头像优化
items: 多人投稿与共同审批现在使用独立圆框头像斜向排列，成员关系更清晰
网页与小程序统一展示更多成员数量，并优化头像加载失败时的占位效果

en.title: Improved collaborative submission avatars
items: Collaborative submissions and reviews now show each member in a separate diagonally stacked avatar
Web and mini program now share clearer overflow counts and resilient avatar fallbacks
